name: PROTOCOL AI ANTI-AIR: RELOCATE AND ANTI-MISSILE
scope: All1380lines of fn_aa.sqf plus XEH_preInit.sqf fully read. Binary startup/dependencies/licence unverified. Original archive unchanged; no raw source copied.

contributions.source: 15km Missile/Rocket nearestObjects query, score from unnormalised velocity dot relative position; no firing-side/hostility/detection filter. Aircraft global8km snapshot with side inequality, class/distance priority.
contributions.cbe: Aircraft IncomingMissile countermeasures/evasion exist. That is not ground AA interception. Native ground vehicle fire control exists but no bounded ground munition-interception executor was found.
contributions.gap: Ground munition detection/admission, hostile origin/closest approach, actual weapon capability/aim/release and layered multi-AA coordination need implementation. Coordinate with AEGIS-M selected intent; do not invent projectile destruction.

contributions.source: assignedVehicleRole turret weapons or gunner weapons, configured magazine lock properties; no loaded/available ammunition proof and fallback doFire on any missile target.
contributions.cbe: Cortex turret/station ammunition policy provides groundwork, not proof that native engine weapon can intercept projectiles.
contributions.gap: Check exact current turret/muzzle, loaded ammunition, native intercept capability and actual shots/hits before claiming CIWS or missile defence.

contributions.intent: Shoot then conceal/relocate and restore search.
contributions.source: WAITING->ENGAGING->RELOCATE->RELOCATING; at most202 random hide candidates with terrain/road/object queries, then findSafePos fallback. Loss of target initiates relocation; disables PATH at rest, forces radar/CARELESS/FULL, double native destination+doMove and velocity zero at arrival.
contributions.cbe: Finite vehicle movement/leases and artillery-style session/expires offer integration groundwork; no source-equivalent ground-AA relocate lifecycle identified.
contributions.gap: Implement ground-AA role/engagement/session-aware relocation through existing driving ownership, retain native radar/task authority, original deadline and safe persistent crew behaviour.

contributions.source: Retries after measured progress window, but AA_LAST_MOVE_TIME updated every moving callback can prevent that window opening.180s timeout rerolls position and resets start, so retries can continue indefinitely.
contributions.cbe: Existing finite movement/recovery budgets are reusable; do not copy time renewal or forced PATH activation.
contributions.gap: Needs AA-specific integration and runtime movement proof.

contributions.source: Creates three SmokeShellPurple objects without inventory or actual launcher.
contributions.cbe: Real inventory/countermeasure firing is separate shared functionality.
contributions.departure: Reject free smoke creation as an AI implementation shortcut.

configurationDefects: Relocation CBA setting name ends in a space, while runtime reads unspaced name.
Disabling global feature exits the worker with PATH/radar/state overrides left behind; re-enable does not start that exited worker in this script.
authorityAndCost: Every0.5s allGroups scan with no locality/Zeus/player/medical/ROE ownership contract.
Reveal target level4 and forced radar/target/fire writes over native knowledge; friendly missiles may be selected.
Heavy hide search and nested waits delay other groups; no per-asset coalesced generation or original bounded episode.
disposition: READABLE_SOURCE_REVIEW_COMPLETE; ground AA anti-munition and relocate functionality remains a real product gap. Aircraft missile evasion is not parity.
